notes.title: Dwarf Digger Begins – I Need Your Support
notes.content:
Welcome, future Miner!

Dwarf Digger is the story of a lone dwarf who decides to dig himself a new life—literally. You build your mine from scratch, gather resources, hunt in the forest, fight monsters, and uncover ancient underground secrets. This is a game where nothing is handed to you—you have to earn everything yourself.

Why was this game created?
Because I've long wanted to make something that combines exploration, survival, and freedom. I wanted you to be able to dig into the earth and not know what you'll find—maybe gold, maybe a monster, or maybe an entrance to something you'd rather not disturb.

We're still at the beginning of this journey.
That’s why I ask just one thing: add Dwarf Digger to your Steam wishlist. It truly makes a difference. For me, it's a sign that it's worth digging deeper, coding more, and improving the project.

If you'd like, follow the game, leave a comment, ask questions—I'm happy to share updates along the way.

Thank you for being here.
See you underground.

With dwarven regards,
Corpix Games
Creator of Dwarf Digger
